title: Policy engine: evaluate autoscaling bounds and emit resolved config for fleet autoscaler
creator: Ethan Park
project: Autoscaling policies with customer bounds (Dedicated Capacity & Fleet Management)
description:
Goal
Add policy evaluation logic that:
1) Enforces min/max bounds semantics at evaluation time (validation + defaulting + normalization)
2) Produces a deterministic, resolved autoscaling policy payload consumed by the fleet autoscaler
3) Preserves backward compatibility with existing Dedicated pools that do not yet have bounds fields

Context
Dedicated autoscaling is gaining customer-configured min/max capacity bounds. The fleet autoscaler must clamp desired replicas within strict bounds, but we also need a single authoritative place where defaults, compatibility behavior, and derived parameters are resolved.

References
- ADR-0142 (bounds semantics): sources/confluence/architecture-and-standards/decision-records/adr-0142-autoscaling-bounds-semantics.json
- Control plane schema doc: sources/confluence/eng-platform/systems-and-services/autoscaling-policy-api-schema.json
- PRD: sources/confluence/product-docs/requirements/autoscaling-bounds-predictive-prd.json

Non-goals
- Implementing clamping in the autoscaler controller (tracked in ENG-2843)
- Predictive signal blending (tracked in ENG-2845)

Proposed approach
Policy engine will output a resolved config block for each DedicatedPool with these properties:
- Resolved bounds:
  - min_replicas_resolved
  - max_replicas_resolved
  - bounds_source (explicit | defaulted | legacy)
- Resolved behavior knobs (with defaults applied):
  - scale_up_cooldown_seconds
  - scale_down_cooldown_seconds
  - max_scale_up_step
  - max_scale_down_step
  - burst_to_max_enabled
  - burst_to_max_cooldown_seconds
- Derived/normalized fields:
  - effective_min_replicas (>= 0, integer)
  - effective_max_replicas (>= effective_min_replicas)
  - actuation_mode (replicas | gpus) based on hardware class (we may still expose min_gpus/min_replicas depending on schema outcome; see open question below)

Semantics to encode (from ADR)
- Max is strict: policy must never emit a resolved max above what customer configured (or defaulted max for legacy pools).
- Min is best-effort during drains/maintenance/capacity shortage: resolved min should remain the configured value, but policy output must include a field indicating whether min is hard-enforced vs best-effort so the autoscaler can log clearly.
- During capacity shortage: max remains strict; min may not be achievable. We still want deterministic evaluation output so the autoscaler can make the best attempt and produce an audit log entry.

Backward compatibility
- Existing pools without bounds should continue to behave like current autoscaling, but with resolved bounds emitted so the autoscaler can treat everything uniformly.
- Defaulting strategy to be aligned with ENG-2850 (backfill). For now:
  - If no bounds set: min_replicas_resolved = current configured baseline replicas (if present) else 0
  - max_replicas_resolved = "unbounded" is NOT allowed for Dedicated; choose a safe platform default by hardware class/region via policy (initially conservative, to be replaced by backfill + customer comms)

Output contract to autoscaler
- The autoscaler consumes the resolved payload as an opaque blob and should not redo validation/defaulting.
- Output must be stable/deterministic for the same input config (important for golden tests and to avoid audit noise).

Acceptance criteria
- Policy engine evaluates Dedicated autoscaling config and returns a resolved block with min/max bounds and cooldown/step defaults.
- Validation errors are clear and include field paths (e.g., autoscaling.min_replicas > autoscaling.max_replicas).
- Deterministic evaluation output: repeated evals (same input) produce identical JSON (field ordering and default inclusion are consistent).
- Test coverage includes:
  - golden tests for representative pool configs (legacy, explicit bounds, invalid bounds)
  - unit tests for defaulting behavior
  - regression test: no policy output change for a legacy pool unless defaults are explicitly added (documented)

Open questions
- Field naming: min_gpus vs min_replicas. Current schema direction in ENG-2841 uses replicas (GPU = replica for Dedicated today). Need to confirm whether we introduce a compatibility shim for any internal callers still sending gpus.
- "Hard min" vs "best-effort min" representation: propose emitting min_enforcement = best_effort (default) with future hard_min reserved for potential enterprise add-on.

Implementation checklist
- [ ] Add policy evaluator module for Dedicated autoscaling config
- [ ] Add defaults table for cooldowns/step limits (to be referenced by docs)
- [ ] Add resolved schema struct + serialization
- [ ] Add golden tests + fixture generator
- [ ] Wire resolved output into policy evaluation response used by fleet autoscaler

Risks
- Default max selection for legacy pools can change spend behavior if we pick poorly; keep conservative and coordinate with ENG-2850/backfill plan.
- Determinism: ensure no map iteration ordering leaks into serialization.
comments: 2026-01-21 (Jordan Lee): Drafted resolved-config schema for policy output. Keeping explicit vs defaulted fields always present to reduce autoscaler branching, but need to ensure we don’t accidentally change behavior for legacy pools. Will add bounds_source to make audit trail clearer.

2026-01-23 (Ethan Park): Please ensure validation errors include pool_id and field path. We’ve had support tickets where customers couldn’t tell which region/pool config failed. Also: determinism matters—golden tests should fail on any default changes.

2026-01-27 (Benji Okafor): +1 on deterministic JSON. Suggest using a canonical marshaller or explicitly sorting keys. Also, can we include resolved defaults even if customer didn’t set them? It’s helpful for debugging, but might be a behavior change if autoscaler starts consuming them immediately. Maybe emit defaults but mark as defaulted and keep autoscaler ignoring until ENG-2843 merges.

2026-01-29 (Jordan Lee): Implemented resolver with defaults and bounds_source. Default cooldowns: up=60s, down=180s. Step limits: +2/-1 replicas per decision by default (can override). Added min_enforcement=best_effort for now per ADR; autoscaler will log when min not met due to drains/shortage.

2026-02-02 (Allison Grant): Please add clamp_reason enum values now (even if autoscaler populates later) so we can standardize dashboards. At least: CLAMP_MAX, CLAMP_MIN, COOLDOWN, RATE_LIMIT, CAPACITY_SHORTAGE, INVALID_CONFIG.

2026-02-04 (Jordan Lee): Landed golden tests for: legacy pool (no bounds), explicit bounds + burst enabled, invalid min>max. JSON output stable. Linked PR below; after merge I’ll coordinate with Keiko on consumption fields so we don’t duplicate defaults in autoscaler.
2026-02-05 (Ethan Park): Merged. Follow-up: document default tables in the schema doc + ensure ENG-2850 backfill aligns with current policy defaults.
